about: Strict-run cases (spec 07 §7.4.2) whose difference from the wasm reference is localised and decided (round REC27, owner decisions 2026-10-23; KB /frontend/lekhjs/recognition/parity-and-corpus.md §5.5). parity.test.ts reports each group under its own key. Only `register` cases are excused from AC-REC-26, and only while the case still fails with `expect`; the other groups are listed, not excused. A listed case that passes, or fails differently, is reported as stale.

register.reason: float32 vs double: the shipped float C++ stages on the TS lines give the reference, the double build gives TS (owner: "Let us accept the float vs double issue i.e. DR-REC-04")

referenceDefect.reason: C++ geometry bug in the reference wasm: LineShape::distanceFrom / intersectionWith (PrimitiveShape.cpp:111-134) read the template's first segment start from MoveToCommand's cached lastPoint_, stale in the hook, so getObjectForConnection's reach around a rectangle's left edge is wrong. TS gives the intended geometry. Owner 2026-10-23: "For C++ bug, let us do nothing" (no C++ fix, no re-capture, no register entry)

lineAggregator.reason: LineMerger.js (lekh-line-merger-N) and the C++ aggregator in the wasm (owner-real-2026-10-17) segment the stroke differently. Owner 2026-10-23: deferred to Work 01M5MJKJ2HHN35B2BEC0WWQ4J1; reproductions in parity/fixtures/rec-linemerger/
